description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses.

description.name: Attach Dark 3 with Secondary Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 5, up to Attach Dark 5
